live_report.protocol_limit: Separate held and moving captures are repeated experimental conditions, not identical performances. Fixed-context controls compare windows within each single capture.

limits: Two performances per label/condition, not a general accuracy estimate.

Timed windows are proxies; fixed normalization uses retrospective full-capture context.
